redacted_summary: Customer subscribed to a prepaid bundle by mistake and asked for a refund within two hours with almost no usage.
resolution: Agent confirmed identity with line + national ID digits, cancelled the bundle, and refunded the full amount to prepaid balance.

redacted_summary: Customer disputed a duplicated VAS charge of about EGP 280.
resolution: Agent verified the charge was wrong; amount was above the 200 EGP agent cap so a supervisor approved the refund.

redacted_summary: Customer wanted to move their number to another network after only two months on the line.
resolution: Request denied under the four-month port-out rule; customer was told the earliest eligible date.

redacted_summary: Customer asked chat to replace a lost SIM immediately.
resolution: Chat refused the SIM swap; customer was directed to a store with ID for the in-person process.

redacted_summary: Prepaid balance was under EGP 5 and the customer asked for emergency Salefny credit.
resolution: Agent confirmed no outstanding Salefny loan and granted the emergency credit.

redacted_summary: Customer tried to transfer EGP 100 of prepaid balance to another line.
resolution: Transfer denied because it exceeded the EGP 50 per-transfer limit; customer split the amount.

redacted_summary: Home internet outage lasted about 36 hours in the customer's area.
resolution: After confirming the outage window, agent granted the standard outage service credit under the approved rule.
